subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for Control UI reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state UX, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of narrower canonicals such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745?
rationale: Current main is partial, and the remaining work defines gateway protocol, session/runtime metadata, sibling runtime parity, and final fallback delivery semantics rather than a narrow mechanical repair.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and the durable fallback-delivery contract, then close or split after those decisions are settled.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a successor as the reply-metadata path and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 as the no-output path, then close this issue only once that split is explicit.

options.title: Accept Current Partial Behavior
options.body: Close this issue as satisfied by Markdown quoting plus the hidden runtime-context text carrier, accepting that exact reply identity is not a first-class contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and the durable fallback-delivery contract, then close or split after those decisions are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main protocol/runtime/UI lines route to Vincent Koc in blame, and the decision crosses those same boundaries.
